purpose: Pin the names PowerShell answers itself, so the frontend refuses to model an assignment to one of them as a plain variable.
note: Measured with `Get-Variable` in the PowerShell pinned in deshell.lock, with no profile, under two conditions: at startup, and after one native command has run. The second condition is not a detail — `LASTEXITCODE` does not exist until a native command sets it, and a list measured only at startup would have let `$LASTEXITCODE = '0'` through as an ordinary assignment. Assigning it changes what a later `exit` reports; assigning `$ErrorActionPreference` changes how the script handles errors. Neither is a value the IR can carry as text. A name absent here is the script's own.
